trello.name: Document prompt injection incident in security log
trello.desc: Owner: Hassan. Write up the prompt injection attempt from the support ticket: include the raw ticket content, what the ticket summarizer actually did (garbled routing summary containing the word 'URGENT'), timestamps, and a severity assessment. File the write-up in the security log. Deadline: this week.

trello.name: Harden ticket pipeline against prompt injection
trello.desc: Owner: Wren. Add a sanitization layer in the ticket parser: quoted customer content must be delimited and treated as data when sent to the summarizer, with instruction-like content stripped or neutralized. Turn this exact ticket into a regression test fixture that feeds it through and checks the summary stays clean. Also add an eval that runs a small suite of injection attempts against the summarizer on every deploy (approved by Grace to be folded into this same task).

trello.name: Investigate password reset email delivery for jdoe443
trello.desc: Owner: Wren. Check the reset email delivery logs for the last week and follow up on the account jdoe443 (the legitimate complaint buried in the injection attempt). If the account is a burner, close it. If resets are actually broken, escalate it into its own incident.

trello.name: Provide list of new service accounts since May
trello.desc: Owner: Hassan. Compile and send Grace a list of all service accounts created since May, to support the quarterly access review. Deadline: Thursday.

trello.name: Run quarterly access review
trello.desc: Owner: Grace. Run the quarterly access review, due Friday, using the list of new service accounts since May provided by Hassan.
